{{/* Email-collection band. data-newsletter axis: photo (default) — full-bleed backdrop photo + scrim, translucent card quiet — plain band on --bg-alt with a solid card envelope | plane | megaphone | mailbox — the quiet band with a big accent line-illustration beside the copy (superset markup: all four icons render; CSS reveals the match) Copy comes from site.json's newsletter block (headline / blurb / button_label) with fed defaults, so the band never renders empty. When the contract carries a signup block (the account can send the confirmation email — docs/newsletter-bot-protection-plan.md §3), the CTA is a real form posting to the /newsletter island: email field, hidden source, the pinned honeypot the server checks by the same name, and the Turnstile widget when a sitekey rides the contract. Without a signup block the CTA stays a mailto against site.json's contact_email. */}} {{ $site := hugo.Data.site }} {{ $author := hugo.Data.author }} {{ $nl := $site.newsletter | default dict }} {{ $signup := $nl.signup | default dict }}
